scope: One fixed offline transport-moment GP comparison on frozen B8 observations; no new acquisition, machine, camera or GUI operations
reference_inputs: B9 exact pool specifications; B8 checkpoints and finite primary curves for evaluation only
moment_parameterization: A=QR; response y_c=Q u_c, three beam coefficients m_c=R^-1 u_c; no positive-definite constraint
candidate_kernel: Matern-5/2, length scale 0.32 inherited from each fixed InfoBAXConfig; no scan-coordinate kernel
prior_covariance: scale^2 * (scan_count/3) * kron(K_candidate, I_3), matching average response variance to M0
prior_mean: Repeat Q.T @ (observed median * ones(scan_count)); observed data only
amplitude_and_likelihood: Same observed-only scale=max(std(target),0.2*abs(median),median(fixed forecast)); same noise^2+1e-10 likelihood
numerics: Stabilize Gaussian covariance in latent coordinates; sample there then map through Q; no physical beam-matrix projection, sample rejection or response-space eigenvalue floor
sampling: At 6 observations stable_seed(summary,policy_seed,M0,0); at 14 reuse B9 enhanced seed stable_seed(p2_b9_physicality,case,policy_seed,history_policy). Same numeric seeds aid reproducibility; no cross-model common-random-number claim across different latent dimensions.
metrics: Candidate/output physicality partitions and unchanged-gate availability
Posterior transport-span energy and per-draw transport residual
Unobserved finite-primary response RMSE/normalized RMSE, standardized residual mean square, interval coverage and NLPD
Paired seed-bootstrap differences, retaining both cases and both history policies together

bootstrap.unit: resample 16 complete policy seeds, keeping both cases and both historical policies; conditional on frozen histories

interpretation: Model predictions and counterfactual recommendations on old histories, not an adaptive policy comparison or a real-machine acceptance result
continuation: Preserve B2-B9. Run this single prior specification without tuning; document whether structural consistency improves physicality and withheld predictions. Separately map existing emittance-optimization interfaces for a future standalone controlled real-machine workflow.
